answer: Rate-metering defends an agent economy by charging every identity a continuous, non-refundable toll in metered compute and bandwidth just to stay active. Honest agents recoup it from real work they perform; a sybil operator instead pays the toll per fake identity, so a thousand clones cost a thousand tolls with no shared discount. The economics mirror pulling copper from low-grade shale ore, where each extra ton adds linear cost, and a whole reef of forged agents simply multiplies that burn, making mass identity forgery unprofitable.
